purpose: Read-only local payload-scope inspection after automatic approval review rejected opaque part35; not permission to retry, upload, change channel, split, or encode payload.
authorization_basis: User explicitly requested immediate GitHub commit/push of new P3-P6 project data. Parent reports destination remains the same existing public repository. This audit supplies inspectable payload facts; it does not override automatic approval review.

object_closure.method: Strict Git index-pack/verify-pack of the original concatenated pack, in temporary scratch object storage; canonical object directory used read-only solely to resolve thin-pack bases. Original packed objects are separated by original pack offsets from any bases appended during temporary --fix-thin. No fetch, push, checkout, project code or Git hook was run.
object_closure.size_field_note: In verify-pack entries, uncompressed_bytes is the zlib-uncompressed stored representation size; for delta entries it describes delta instructions, not the reconstructed blob. Canonical reconstructed blob bytes are recorded separately as bytes/canonical_blob_bytes.

changed_files.counting_rule: Exact path comparison with rename detection disabled; content-addressed shard renames appear as added/deleted paths. The diff --stat with rename detection may report fewer logical files.

part35_content_mapping.meaning: part35 is a contiguous raw slice of one valid Git bundle. It is not a separately decoded archive; its exact compressed-object spans below map to canonical target files.

excluded_material_checks.credential_pattern_scan_scope: Every original bundle blob, not credential stores or arbitrary workspace files; matched values are never printed.
excluded_material_checks.preexisting_canonical_pdf_note: Any PDF already in the canonical prerequisite history is not newly sent when absent from original bundle blob paths.
excluded_material_checks.limits: Exact Git closure and full checkpoint hashes prove the payload equals the specified canonical increment. Pattern scanning is supplementary and cannot prove the absence of every conceivable undocumented sensitive string; no network permission or upload authorization is granted by this report.

next_action_constraint: Keep uploads stopped until the root reviews these transparent facts under the automatic approval feedback. This report must not be treated as permission to bypass a denial through another channel, smaller pieces, encoding changes, or another actor.
